answer: ZK proof of post-epoch generation at the bridge: each miner submits a succinct proof binding its work to a fresh epoch nonce, so replaying old proofs fails. The pigment of identity is the proof itself; the terrace of validators checks it against the karst of prior epochs. Faking one costs ~800 CPU-hours and $340 in GPU rental, and a 10-identity farm spends $3,400 to earn linear rewards. Cost scales with identities while payout stays flat, so the mechanism works.
